selection.design: Five nurse-count strata; each has an anchor, a controlled history contrast and a controlled demand contrast.
selection.weekly_data_ranking: Within each scenario, sort WD0..WD9 by total minimum staff-days, peak daily minimum, then WD number. Anchor uses lower median (rank 5/10). Contrast uses the first or last rank, alternating higher/lower across nurse counts.
selection.history_design: Within each stratum, keep WD fixed for the history pair and history fixed for the demand pair. Each of H0/H1/H2 occurs five times overall. Every history pair changes eligibility for actually required Monday slots.
selection.scope: 15 independent Monday-Sunday week-zero inputs. Horizon labels are source metadata, not weeks simulated. Nurse count also varies with scenario skill/shift mix, so this is descriptive stratification, not an isolated causal effect of nurse count.
limitations: Purposive subset of 690 inputs, not a random or exhaustive sample.
No multiweek progression or history advancement.
No cases selected or replaced based on new model performance.
No deliberate infeasible-case construction; feasibility is established by Solution A, or remains unknown.
